text: Phone notifications: messages, new followers, likes and comments, trades closed in profit and leaderboard moves. A new device that logs in to your account sends you a security email.
Community: tap a name on the leaderboard to open that member's profile, then follow or message them.

When a broker's servers are down for maintenance, FTM keeps managing open trades and restarts copying by itself as soon as the broker is back. Members get an email and a phone notification when copying runs again.
Comments in Community now take emoji and stickers.
Free accounts can now see the leaderboard.

Every figure on the dashboard has a small i that explains exactly how it is calculated. Profit this year is time-weighted, so deposits and withdrawals do not change it; drawdown is measured on the closed balance.
The Year by year table on Performance is simpler: start, net deposits, profit, end and return for each year, with every month in the table below it.
The monthly Letter from FTM: every member gets the month's figures and what changed, in their own language.
Every evening FTM news in Community shows the FTM master account's result of the day, trade by trade, and members get it by email. On Fridays also the week, and on the 1st the month before.
Community posts now fit small phone screens exactly.
Service status: one page shows whether every FTM service is running now, with 90 days of hourly checks. Find it at the bottom of the homepage and in Customer support.
Calendar: a day's pop-up now carries the FTM logo, the account's balance and its risk profile. Closing a trade's details takes you back to that day, not to the calendar.
Performance has a new Trade statistics section: winning, losing, long and short trades, trades per day, week and month, the busiest day, streaks, time in a trade and the most traded market.

Trade statistics now also show when FTM started trading on the account, its last trade, days without trading, the longest pause, open trades, trades this week and month, markets traded and lots traded.
Homepage on phones: the FTM MACHINE chart now sits under "Made for busy people", and the FTM Investment timeline rises from Day 1 at the bottom to Year 5 at the top.
Homepage on phones: the Performance section now shows the two key figures, average yearly return and profitable years.
Homepage: the Markets section now shows the five markets FTM trades: forex, stocks, commodities, crypto and stock indices.
Homepage: smiling faces of FTM members now surround "Join 50K+ people worldwide", and the support example shows how to set up FTM MACHINE.
Phone menu: Get started and Create a free account now sit at the bottom of the menu; Log in stays at the top of the screen.
Homepage: the "Power of MT5" block is removed; "Trade the way you want" now leads with defined risk on every trade.
Homepage: the closing headline now reads "Join other people worldwide".
Homepage: the FTM score line now reads "4.5 out of 5 based on Performance".
Homepage: the "Trade the way you want" heading is removed.
Homepage: the "Defined risk on every trade" card now shows a gold trade with its take profit, current price, entry and stop loss, the take profit twice as far as the stop loss.
Homepage: the figures strip now shows 1M+ customers worldwide, monthly volume and the year FTM was established, with "Vision 2030" underneath.
Homepage: the figures strip now shows 10M+ customers worldwide and $1T+ monthly volume.
Terms and Conditions and the Privacy Policy can now be read in all 50 languages, with a language picker at the top of each page.
Homepage: "All your markets in one place" now shows FTM MACHINE trading each market live on a phone, with the open trade in profit and the Portfolio since 2020.
Daily, weekly and monthly result emails now show each member's own account. The FTM master account's results stay on FTM news in Community.
Homepage: the investment timeline (Day 1 to End of year 5) was removed; the four key facts above it stay.
Homepage: the faces around "Join other people worldwide" now show each person's whole face.
Account statements: besides All time, a year or a month, you can now choose your own dates (Custom dates: From and To).
Performance: the year table no longer shows a "Dividends, tax & adjustments" note under End.
Change password now emails you a link; you choose the new password from that link, so nobody who learns your password can lock you out.
Logging in again always opens the Dashboard with your figures (it could show an empty page before).
New in the account menu: Your devices. See every device your account is logged in on and sign all the others out with one tap.
Account statements now include a Performance chart: your balance through the period you choose, deposits and withdrawals marked, the period's return and the highest and lowest balance.
Account statements show the exact dates they cover (from and to) at the top and on the chart, also for All time, a year or a month.

Your monthly statement now arrives by email on the last day of every month at 23:00, with a button to download the PDF. The Friday email is now a short weekly summary: result, trades, winning trades and markets.
Statements show the full FTM logo, and when trades are open, the open trades, floating P/L and equity.
Community: each post shows its two most liked comments with a View all button, and adding an emoji or sticker to a comment keeps your text until you press Send.
Account progress chart: 'Compare with' now lists all five FTM markets plus the S&P 500, Silver and five top stocks (Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Google).
Risk level card: under the drawdown it now says Very healthy (green), Healthy or Risky, depending on where the drop sits against your profile's normal range.
Client-area menu: the round picture beside your name now shows your Community photo (or the first letter of your name if you have no photo yet).
Community Discover: each member card now shows their FTM profit % (green or red) next to followers and following, and the Follows you label is a neat pill beside the country.

Community photos: when you choose a profile photo or a photo for a post, an editor opens first so you can move, zoom and rotate it, and choose the shape (round for the profile photo; Original, Square, Portrait or Wide for posts).
Community messages now appear in the chat the moment you press Send; if the connection drops, the message says 'Not sent' and one tap sends it again.
Community: when someone you follow, or someone who follows you, changes their profile photo or profile, you get a notification.
Client area speed: sections open two to four times faster on phones and the site no longer does background work while you are just looking.
Compare with: ten more big markets (Dow Jones, DAX, crude oil, EUR/USD, Ethereum, Tesla, Meta, Berkshire Hathaway, TSMC, JPMorgan). The account chart now says 'FTM MACHINE is trading for you'.
Free members now also get the result emails: the FTM master account's daily result, Friday weekly summary and end-of-month statement.
New sign-in email: clearer wording; 'This wasn't me' now reads 'FTM logs you out on every device and sends you a link to choose a new password.'

Plan reminders: from one month before a plan ends (5 Years, or an Annual whose automatic renewal was cancelled) you get a weekly email until you renew. After a plan ends there is a one-month grace period with weekly reminders; after it you are logged out until you renew with the same email.
Daily results: on busy days (more than 6 trades) the email and the FTM news card show one line per market (trades, buys and sells, net P/L) instead of every trade, so it fits on a phone.
Daily result email: on a day your account closed no trade, a short note now explains why (no trade met the rules, trades still open, or on small accounts the broker's minimum trade size).
Welcome emails are back: new free members and new customers get a short series of emails from FTM (how it works, how to connect your account, your client area), in their own language.
Open positions on the dashboard now move gently from right to left and show every open trade, not only the first four.
New visitors see the free sign-up once, after 20 seconds on the site, with a close button; customers and anyone who has already seen it are never asked again.
The Service status page now lists any problem from the last 14 days: the day, the service and how many hourly checks found it.
New FTM affiliate programme: apply on the site, get your own link and code, and earn 10% of every subscription payment of the people you bring; they get 5% off their first payment.
Partner with FTM now leads with FTM's own affiliate programme, then Deriv affiliate via FTM and Introducing broker. The affiliate page is also in the account menu, so it is one tap away on phones.
On iPhones, balances, account numbers and codes no longer turn into phone-number links on the site and in FTM emails.
Community: you can now share links and phone numbers in messages, posts, comments and your profile. Tap a link to open it or a number to call it.
The YouTube button on the website now opens FTM's new YouTube channel.
If you sign up and don't click the email link, FTM now reminds you with a fresh link after 3 hours and once more after 3 days.
Opening a broker account: you can now choose Deriv or Exness. "Open account" and the new "No broker account yet? Create one" link in the client area take you to the choice.
Buttons in rows of cards now line up exactly, and refreshing the page always starts at the top.
If you signed up but have not activated your free account yet, we now remind you after 3 hours, 3 days and 7 days, in your language.

New "Is it really FTM?" check (footer > Fraud prevention, and Customer support in the client area): FTM's official website, email addresses and social media accounts in one place, with two simple safety rules, so you can spot fake FTM pages and messages.
Trust engine: the month window now fits every phone screen and stays still, and lists every trade week by week (tap a week to jump to its trades).
Homepage: a new FTM MACHINE card with the real Portfolio growth curve for Growth 2× and Balanced, smoothly rolling figures, and the % and date when you touch the chart.
Homepage markets: every Learn more now opens that market on the trust engine (Forex: USD/JPY, Stocks: US Tech 100, Commodities: Gold, Crypto: Bitcoin, Stock indices: HK50).
Client area: open positions refresh every 5 seconds, and a trade that opens or closes updates your closed trades, balance and statistics at once.
Affiliates: Master affiliate earns 20% of every subscription payment. You become one automatically at 10 paying customers, and your Affiliate page shows your progress.

Affiliates: Apply now opens the application form at once on every phone. Applying also opens your free FTM account; one email confirms the review and lets you set your password straight into your Affiliate page.
Affiliates: applications are answered within 24 hours, and approval emails now open with congratulations.
Affiliate commissions and investment withdrawals are paid in USDT (cryptocurrency) to your own wallet; add your USDT network and address on the Affiliate or Withdraw page.
Affiliates can tap "Invest in FTM" to put their payable commission straight into their FTM investment instead of a payout.
Investment withdrawals: a missing or wrong USDT address or amount is marked in red, and a request above what is available says "Insufficient funds" before anything is sent.
Daily result emails now show one line per market and direction (Buy or Sell) with its combined result, and a short note on loss days.
No-trade emails for smaller accounts now explain that an account below the recommended size takes part in about 60% of trades.
The Facebook button at the bottom of the homepage now opens FTM's current Facebook page.
A Telegram button now sits with the other social buttons at the bottom of the homepage.
A LinkedIn button now sits with the other social buttons at the bottom of the homepage.
FTM emails now come from ftm@ftmwealthnation.com, our own address, so they reach the inbox more reliably and replies reach our team.
Daily result emails now arrive at 18:00 (Berlin) and cover the last 24 hours, 18:00 to 18:00, the same as our 6 p.m. posts.
A "Rate us on Trustpilot" button now sits under "What our customers say" on the homepage.
Tap any period in Performance (this week, this month, the year…) to see which markets drove the result, best to worst, losses included.
On phones, Auto Trading on the "How would you like to join?" page now has the same gold frame as on laptops.
Result emails for accounts below 2,000 now show the FTM master account's % next to yours when it did better in the same period.
The statistics pop-up for each period now shows when its figures were last updated.
One clear FTM MACHINE section with a video, and one Activate button: choose your plan from a list and pay in one step.
The FTM MACHINE section shows the live account's real daily results as alerts next to the video.
The FTM MACHINE videos are reframed so the people are clearly visible next to the live results, and the laptops now carry the FTM logo.
The FTM MACHINE chart on the homepage now also shows the Conservative profile, next to Growth 2× and Balanced.
